messages:
Lena: Morning everyone — quick happy news dump: I accepted the Eng Manager role  (starting next sprint) and Noah and his partner are expecting in June ! Also shoutout to Sam for 3 years today 389. Can we do a tiny lunchtime thing?
Sam: wait what, thank you!!! three whole years, wow. cake? confetti? :party_parrot:
Noah: we're over the moon. baby name still TBD. thanks for all the love 60a
Isha: yay congrats all! poll: react with one: 1️⃣ cake + card @12:30, 2️⃣ sushi potluck, 3️⃣ group gift card, 4️⃣ virtual card only
Lena: 1️⃣ for me, small celebration please. GF option if possible.
Sam: 2️⃣ I can bring savory sides if people want.
Noah: 3️⃣ no pressure, just happy to celebrate you all.
Kudos-bot: Lena promoted -> Engineering Manager. Badge awarded :medal: 
CalendarBot: Event created: "Lunchtime mini-celebration: Lena, Sam, Noah" on 2026-04-02 12:30 in Main Kitchen. Invite posted to #random.
Isha: I'll order a small cake + GF slices. Sam, pls bring your sides if you said you'd do potluck.
Lena: thanks team, keeping it chill but means a lot 64f
Sam: bringing in mini sammies and my infamous pickled carrots. be gentle :joy:
